domains.name: ecology
visual_languages: a living wetland redirecting water
fungal threads exchanging resources
a forest reclaiming an abandoned structure
domains.analogy_warning: Ecological systems are not minds; borrow the relation pattern, not biological authority.

domains.name: immunology
visual_languages: a customs gate learning which travelers belong
sentinel cells passing colored tokens
a security system relearning a harmless visitor
domains.analogy_warning: Psychological beliefs are not immune cells; keep the mapping explicitly metaphorical.

domains.name: architecture
visual_languages: people flowing through a changing floor plan
a doorway moving while walls stay still
weight traveling through beams into the ground
domains.analogy_warning: Built-space behavior can illuminate structure but does not establish cognitive mechanism.

domains.name: music theory
visual_languages: mechanical instruments falling into phase
a melody changing the color of a room
two moving lines meeting without becoming identical
domains.analogy_warning: Musical tension is a formal and felt pattern, not direct evidence about reality.

domains.name: law
visual_languages: evidence tags moving through transparent hands
a courtroom built from competing maps
a chain of sealed containers crossing rooms
domains.analogy_warning: Legal standards are designed institutions; they are useful tests, not natural laws of belief.

domains.name: information theory
visual_languages: a signal crossing a storm of static
a message rebuilding itself from redundant fragments
a vast scene compressed into a tiny moving code
domains.analogy_warning: Information metaphors can hide embodiment and meaning; label the level of comparison.

domains.name: control theory
visual_languages: a thermostat chasing a moving target
a pendulum correcting after each disturbance
a ship autopilot learning crosswind
domains.analogy_warning: A person is not a simple controller; use the mechanism to ask questions, not reduce experience.

domains.name: evolution
visual_languages: one tool becoming useful for an unintended task
a sequence of imperfect bridges
forms branching through changing terrain
domains.analogy_warning: Evolution has no foresight; do not turn selection into cosmic intention.

domains.name: theatre
visual_languages: a stage rotating behind an actor
spotlights changing which set appears real
costumes moving between empty chairs
domains.analogy_warning: Performance metaphors illuminate identity but should not imply feelings are fake.

domains.name: logistics
visual_languages: packages rerouting through a warehouse
traffic finding alternate bridges
a conveyor pausing behind one blocked gate
domains.analogy_warning: Efficiency is not the same as human value; do not optimize away care or meaning.

domains.name: archaeology
visual_languages: a room reconstructed from scattered objects
layers of soil revealing different maps
fragments forming several possible vessels
domains.analogy_warning: Reconstruction remains uncertain; preserve multiple plausible stories.

domains.name: cybernetics
visual_languages: a camera changing the machine it observes
a control room nested inside its own screen
mirrors adjusting each other through motors
domains.analogy_warning: Cybernetic description is not proof that consciousness is literally a machine.
